title: Aspherical Manifolds Admit No Metric of Positive Scalar Curvature
exact_target: Does asphericity rule out every everywhere-positive scalar-curvature metric on a closed manifold?

sources.citation: Simone Cecchini, Jianchun Chu, and Jintian Zhu, Positive scalar curvature metrics and aspherical summands, arXiv:2312.04698v3 (2025), introduction.
